description: 车腾挪h6，清开g列让后杀攻
explanation_en: White sacrifices the rook to clear the g-file for the queen. The queen then drives the king into a mating net, finished by the f-pawn.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白车在g6，挡住了白后从g2到g5的路线。如何清开g列发动杀攻？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's rook on g6 blocks the queen's route from g2 to g5. How can White clear the g-file and start a mating attack?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxh6+！车牺牲腾挪，清开g6——白后从g2冲入g5，步步将杀！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxh6+ sacrifices the rook to clear g6. The queen then invades on g5 and drives the king into a mating net, with f5# to finish.

moves.popup: 白车Rxh6+！牺牲自身，腾挪g6——g列通路打开，白后可进g5！
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the rook with Rxh6+, clearing g6 and opening the g-file for the queen to enter on g5.

moves.popup: 黑王Kxh6——被迫到h6，g列完全清空！
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to capture on h6, leaving the g-file completely clear.

moves.popup: 白后Qg5+！g列已通，后冲入g5将军！
moves.popup_en: White's queen enters on g5 with check through the cleared file.

moves.popup: 白后Qh4+！步步紧逼——Kg6, f5将杀！
moves.popup_en: White checks with Qh4+, continuing the attack and preparing the mating finish after Kg6.
The black king moves to g6.

moves.popup: f5将杀！兵腾挪的余波——绝杀！
moves.popup_en: f5# is checkmate, completing the attack made possible by the clearance.
